## Installation

```r
# Install from CRAN (if available)
install.packages("forestplots")

# Or install the development version from GitHub
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ForestPlots/forestplots-r")
```

## Authentication

<!--
  TODO: Explain how to authenticate the R package with a user's ForestPlots.net credentials or API token.
-->

```r
library(forestplots)

# Authenticate with your credentials
fp_auth(username = "your_username", password = "your_password")

# Or use an API token (recommended)
fp_auth(token = "your_api_token")
```

## Loading data into R

<!--
  TODO: Show how to pull data directly from ForestPlots.net into R using the package.
-->

```r
# Download stem data for a specific plot
stems <- fp_get_stems(plot_code = "BOL-01")

# Download all plots you have access to
my_plots <- fp_get_plots()
```

## Working with the downloaded CSV files

<!--
  TODO: Show how to load and join the CSV files downloaded from the platform (for users not using the R package directly).
-->

```r
# Load stem data
stems <- read.csv("stems.csv")

# Load plot metadata
plots <- read.csv("plots.csv")

# Join tables
library(dplyr)
data <- left_join(stems, plots, by = "PlotCode")
```
